selection_rule: Uniformly shuffle UTC Monday starts from 2022-01-03 through 2025-12-22 after excluding the three development weeks and the prior seed-8108 diagnostic weeks; accept the first 12 starts at least 28 days apart. Dates were committed before the auction-regime decomposition result was read.
purpose: Evaluate exactly one economically selected auction state without changing the completed-level, FVG, consequent-encroachment, one-minute MSS, micro-invalidation, external-target, or cost contract.
regime_selection_rule: After development decomposition, select at most one predeclared regime only if it has positive total and mean cost-after net-R proxy, at least two positive development weeks, at least eight eligible events, and representation across multiple assets. Otherwise run no holdout and discard the path.
promotion_rule: The unchanged selected regime must remain positive in aggregate, have at least seven of twelve positive weeks, avoid any single week contributing more than half of total positive proxy, and retain opportunity across at least three assets before NautilusTrader implementation.
